title: •Tactical Re-Call
caption: •Tactical Re-Call (V)
game_text: Use 2 Force to deploy on opponent’s site. Target opponent’s leader at a site or character at the Galactic Senate. Target’s game text is canceled. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.
lore: Sophisticated communication equipment hidden in the ruins of the extinct Massassi race is used to coordinate forces and to re-call Rebel officers for debriefing and orders.
